name: Voxel Caching with Cuckoo Hashing
definition: An optional voxel cache using Cuckoo hashing to store labels $\lambda$ for tuples of voxel coordinates $v \in \mathbb{N}^3$ and requested LODs $l$, allowing direct access without one-frame latency.
summary: Voxel Caching with Cuckoo Hashing is an optional voxel cache using Cuckoo hashing to store labels for voxel coordinates and LODs, enabling direct access without one-frame latency.
